concerns.adapter_policy: Package adapters may translate local metric, log, and SLO vocabulary to polisyos.core.observability; they must not define competing cross-package telemetry APIs.
concerns.name: observability

concerns.adapter_policy: Package-local security modules may translate bounded-context authorization, quality-gate, or audit vocabulary to polisyos.core.security; they must not define competing cross-package security APIs.
concerns.name: security

concerns.adapter_policy: Package registries may remain bounded-context catalogs; cross-component registry contracts must route through polisyos.core.registry.
concerns.name: registry

concerns.adapter_policy: Package-local discovery modules may adapt local plugin or evidence discovery behavior; shared discovery contracts use polisyos.core.discovery.
concerns.name: discovery

concerns.adapter_policy: Package-local config modules may define bounded-context options; shared process configuration uses polisyos.common.config.
concerns.name: configuration

concerns.adapter_policy: Tracing helpers should adapt to polisyos.core.trace records and sinks and must not create a competing trace API.
concerns.name: tracing

concerns.adapter_policy: Telemetry helpers should adapt package-local metric vocabulary to polisyos.core.observability.
concerns.name: telemetry

concerns.adapter_policy: Package-local calibration modules may adapt method- or producer-specific calibration signals; shared calibration diagnostics use polisyos.calibration.
concerns.name: calibration

findings.suggested_target: package-local implementation module or dated facade exception
scientist domain packages with root-file compatibility shims
tests/_helpers contract and layer-local conftest policy
caller report for each sunset shim

repeated_first_level_names.name: _adapters
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Private adapter capsules are allowed only as package-qualified bridges into canonical cross-cutting homes.

repeated_first_level_names.name: _impl
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Package-private implementation capsules are allowed only behind package facades and must not become cross-package import surfaces.

repeated_first_level_names.name: _internal
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Private implementation capsules are intentionally repeated across bounded contexts and must remain package-qualified.

repeated_first_level_names.name: adapters
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Adapter packages are package-owned integration seams and do not define a repository-wide adapter API.

repeated_first_level_names.name: artifacts
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Core artifact primitives, Foundry method artifacts, IR artifact projections, and Scientist public decision artifacts are separate bounded-context concepts.

repeated_first_level_names.name: calibration
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: polisyos.calibration is the canonical diagnostics home; DDM and Foundry calibration packages remain bounded-context adapters.

repeated_first_level_names.name: claims
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Fabric claim processing and Scientist claim reasoning are package-local concerns.

repeated_first_level_names.name: connectors
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Fabric executable connectors and IR connector bridge contracts are package-qualified surfaces.

repeated_first_level_names.name: contracts
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Contracts are owned by each bounded context unless promoted through polisyos.core.contracts.

repeated_first_level_names.name: data_plane
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Fabric and Foundry data-plane names describe separate execution contexts.

repeated_first_level_names.name: evidence
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Fabric evidence materialization and Scientist evidence reasoning remain package-local concepts.

repeated_first_level_names.name: extensions
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Extension packages are package-owned authoring surfaces governed by architecture/extension_points.toml.

repeated_first_level_names.name: feedback
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Foundry execution feedback and Scientist decision feedback are separate bounded-context workflows.

repeated_first_level_names.name: governance
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Core, IR, and Scientist governance roots are package-qualified, with Scientist legacy governance peers handled by the Wave 2 family audit.

repeated_first_level_names.name: kernel
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Kernel packages are package-specific runtime kernels and are not cross-package APIs.

repeated_first_level_names.name: methods
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Foundry method catalog and Scientist method taxonomy are distinct; Scientist legacy method peers are handled by the Wave 2 family audit.

repeated_first_level_names.name: migrations
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Common and IR migration helpers are package-local.

repeated_first_level_names.name: quality
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Data Forge, Fabric, and Runtime quality packages own distinct quality semantics and remain package-qualified.

repeated_first_level_names.name: registry
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: polisyos.core.registry owns generic registry primitives; Fabric, Foundry, and IR registries are domain adapters or semantic contract groups.

repeated_first_level_names.name: runtime
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: polisyos.runtime is canonical; Foundry runtime remains package-local glue pending rename or facade fold-in.

repeated_first_level_names.name: schemas
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Top-level schema wrappers and IR schema helpers are separate schema/data concerns.

repeated_first_level_names.name: security
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: polisyos.core.security is canonical; package security modules adapt local resources to core security primitives.

repeated_first_level_names.name: validation
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Foundry and Scientist validation are separate package concepts; Scientist verification and policy_verified are Wave 2 subpackage moves.

repeated_first_level_names.name: world
repeated_first_level_names.rationale: Fabric and IR world packages describe different bounded-context world models.

name_collisions.scope: src/polisyos first-level package directories plus top-level package roots

families.label: Scientist workflow/orchestration/orchestrator/research DAG roots
families.rationale: Wave 2 keeps orchestration as the active implementation boundary, merges workflow builders below orchestration/workflows, and keeps old workflow/orchestrator/research_dag roots only as smoke-tested shims if import evidence requires it.

families.label: Scientist methods versus legacy search/discovery/research roots
families.rationale: Wave 2 moves active search, discovery, research DAG, causal, autotune, backtesting, and DOE implementations below methods; first-level roots become registered shims only where import evidence requires them.

families.label: Scientist extensions versus repository extension registries
families.rationale: Extension packages are package-scoped authoring surfaces, while architecture/extension_points.toml owns cross-package entry-point policy; Scientist registry modules remain local implementation registries unless promoted by a later ABI decision.

families.label: Scientist governance, validation, verification, and policy-verified roots
families.rationale: Wave 2 moves continuous governance and human review below governance, moves verification and policy_verified below validation, and leaves current first-level roots as dated compatibility shims only where import evidence requires them.

scientist_parallel_implementations.scope: Scientist old/new implementation families scheduled for Wave 2 closeout
